title: Factory desired definition (offline; not native readiness)

localPath.$comment: Relative to explicit --repo. Symlinks and overlapping skill directories are unsupported. factory.yaml is reserved in the staged project root. References must exist; JSON Schema alone cannot prove filesystem safety.

markdown.$comment: Nonempty valid UTF-8 file. Skill directories require SKILL.md; all selected files are nonempty regular files.

$comment: Offline parser accepts one YAML 1.2 core document; refuses parser errors/warnings, duplicate keys, explicit tags, anchors/aliases and directives. No interpolation/evaluation/includes. Limits include raw definition bytes. Valid desired selection does not qualify native execution.
